title: Unit 1: All About Us & School Life

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Daily Routines & School Subjects
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Daily Routines & School Subjects.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK Lớp 5.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.term: Adverbs of Frequency (Trạng từ chỉ tần suất)
concepts.definition: Words that describe how often an action happens: always (100%), usually (80%), often (60%), sometimes (40%), rarely (10%), never (0%).
concepts.example: I always brush my teeth before going to bed. He never arrives late for school.
concepts.essence: Placed before normal verbs and after the verb 'to be'.

concepts.definition: Subject + Verb(s/es) for singular third-person (He/She/It). Used for facts, habits, and daily timetables.
concepts.example: She walks to school every morning. They play football after class.
concepts.essence: Mastering the 's/es' verb ending is the cornerstone of elementary grammar.

rules.statement: Position of Adverbs of Frequency in a sentence
rules.meaning: S + Adverb + Verb (e.g., I often read books) OR S + to be + Adverb (e.g., She is always cheerful).
rules.example: He usually does his homework at 7 p.m.
rules.essence: Do not place adverbs of frequency between a verb and its direct object.

workedExamples.prompt: Put the words in the correct order: 'school / goes / Nam / to / always / on / foot.'
steps: Bước 2: Trạng từ chỉ tần suất 'always' đứng trước động từ thường 'goes'.
Bước 3: Cụm chỉ nơi chốn và phương tiện: 'to school on foot'.
Bước 4: Ghép câu hoàn chỉnh: 'Nam always goes to school on foot.'
workedExamples.answer: Nam always goes to school on foot.

commonMistakes.mistake: Writing 'She go to school' instead of 'She goes to school'.
commonMistakes.why: With third-person singular subjects (He, She, It), the verb must take -s or -es.
